title: Observe-only bracket advisor: per bar, per live position, log the SL/TP the validated levers / model would set beside the live bracket (Tier-2 PROPOSAL)
note: [2026-10-24 lane ATM-AI-MERGE] PROPOSAL ONLY -- not built, not approved; any PR is a held Tier-2 proposal. WHY: the parity and evidence path before any Tier-3 bracket flip in AI active trade management (Programme 01 section 'AI active trade management'). Today position_path_history (EXIT-PATH-TELEMETRY-LIVE, done) records the live bracket per bar; nothing records what a candidate rule or model WOULD set on the same bar, so harness-vs-live parity of an undeclared lever can only be checked after a Tier-3 declare. PROPOSED SHAPE: phase 0 (no model needed): in the same monitor pass, compute the SL/TP each confirmed-but-undeclared rule lever would set for that leg using the SAME functions as the harness (src/research/trail_levers.py, src/runtime/momentum_levers.py, src/runtime/tp_revision.py) and write advisor_sl_r / advisor_tp_r / advisor_source (lever or model id + version) beside sl_r/tp_r on the position_path_history row (a projection on the same pass; never read by the exit path; never raises). Phase 1: the model output of the first AI-ATM rung that PASSES (09a6-01/03/04, d6e7-06). Read path: the existing diag route for path history. PARITY: the offline harness on the same bars reproduces advisor values (exit-refinement P5) on 1-2 live trades per leg. TIER-2 (runtime writer): prepare + validate, one operator OK, ship, verify. Tier-3 flip of any bracket stays separate and needs an offline PASS plus the advisor parity read. Not on the critical path for rungs A1/B1/C1; it is on the critical path for any live bracket-moving model.
